rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Foster's Wellington Cup
Exhibition name: Mount Hood
rows.Origin:
Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1984).
Introduced in New Zealand by McGredy Roses International (New Zealand) as 'Foster's Wellington Cup'.
rows.Bloom: Cream or white blend. White, shading to cream at centre. Moderate, old rose fragrance. 40 to 48 petals. Medium to large, very full (41+ petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, ruffled bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Medium, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, dense. Large, glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 47" to 5¼' (120 to 160cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower, exhibition or garden. Disease susceptibility: susceptible to blackspot . Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Breeder's notes: Fosters' Wellington Cup - Macmouhoo. Nicknamed Mount Hood.
